description: AI coding agent with dual runtime, 16 providers, Guardian safety, progressive tools, and dual frontends (TUI + GUI)

architecture.core_principle: Two packages, one boundary rule: clew/ (core) never imported directly by clew_tui/. Communication exclusively through clew_tui.bridge.ClewBridge which owns a plain AgentRuntime.

clew.description: Core agent runtime, providers, web bridge (Qt GUI), tools, collaboration, persistence, token management
key_modules: agent_runtime/runtime.py - Legacy AgentRuntime (5750 lines) - ReAct loop, ToolEngine, PromptBuilder, ContextMemory
agent/runtime.py - AgentRuntimeV2 - wraps legacy + adds ChatStateActor, CircuitBreaker, CompactionEngine, InterjectionBuffer, SubagentV2, Sandbox
agent/actor.py - ChatStateActor (asyncio single-task state owner)
agent/circuit_breaker.py - CircuitBreakerRegistry with native/fallback, sliding window error tracking
agent/compaction_v2.py - Three-tier CompactionEngine (code/intra/inter)
agent/interjection.py - InterjectionBuffer for mid-turn user input
agent/sandbox.py - Landlock/Seatbelt kernel sandbox (WORKSPACE/READ_ONLY/STRICT profiles)
agent/subagent_v2.py - Built-in explore/plan/general-purpose with toolset-level read-only guarantee
agent/guardian.py - Rule-based risk scoring + optional LLM review (APPROVE/REJECT/MODIFY) + subagent reviewer
agent/context_fragments.py - Marker-based context fragments (<context_fragment type=... id=...>) preserved across compaction
providers/registry.py - ProviderRegistry singleton, 16 built-in providers, custom provider auto-registration, reload_registry()
providers/custom_providers.py - YAML config, dynamic class creation, plugin dir auto-discovery (~/.clew/providers/)
providers/nvidia_nim.py - NvidiaNIMProvider extending OpenAICompatProvider
web_bridge/bridge.py - QObject with @Slot methods for GUI, owns AgentRuntime, emits Qt signals
token_budget.py - TokenBudget config (daily/monthly USD caps, per-turn knobs, predictable-mode, prompt-caching), check_budget()
token_tracker.py - TokenTracker with 30-day rotation, MODEL_PRICING table, live pricing override
request_queue.py - RequestQueue per provider (max_concurrency, cooldown after 429, exponential backoff), QueueRegistry, wrap_provider()
collaboration.py - 4 modes (Reviewer, Codegen, Pair, Observer) via SwarmManager, runtime-agnostic run_agent_fn
capability_catalog.py - 20 built-in templates across 9 categories, $placeholder$ substitution, project/user/global override layers
second_opinion.py - Cross-model review (different provider family), Pro-gated, fails OPEN, verdict schema mirrors Guardian
progressive_tools.py - TOOL_CATALOG ~44 tools, select_tools + search_tools meta-tools, fold_announced_tool_names()
session/sqlite_persistence.py - SQLitePersistence (sessions, messages tables, WAL, load_range), ContextMemory auto-dispatch
activity_log.py - ActivityLog (bounded deque, thread-safe, subscribable, export_json, categories/statuses)
skill_loader.py - SKILL.md format with YAML frontmatter, project/user/global priority
slash_commands.py - SlashCommandManager (.claude/commands/ discovery, $ARGUMENTS expansion)
quota.py - QuotaTracker (per-section daily limits, file locking, 30-day rotation)
context_manager.py - ContextManager (file scoring, token budget, pin/mark_accessed)
project_context.py - ProjectContext (CLEW.md primary, CLAUDE.md fallback, .clew/ + .claude/ supplementary)

clew_tui.description: Textual TUI frontend. Never imports clew internals. Communicates via ClewBridge.
key_modules: app.py - ClewTUIApp with 20+ slash commands (/capabilities, /second_opinion, /verify, /budget, /guardian, /collab, /queue, /storage, /sessions, /context, /tools), VerificationModal, worker threads

bridge.py - ClewBridge boundary (list_providers, set_provider, list_capabilities, get_capability, fill_capability_template, is_pro_enabled, set_pro_enabled, get_second_opinion_config, set_second_opinion_config, run_second_opinion, list_second_opinion_providers, get_token_budget, set_token_budget, reset_token_budget, check_budget, verify_last_response)
widgets/verification_modal.py - ModalScreen with PASS/WARN/FAIL color coding, 2x2 sub-verdict grid
widgets/command_palette.py - Fuzzy search command palette
widgets/chat_log.py - Chat display with markdown rendering
widgets/approval_modal.py - 3-button modal (Approve/Reject/Use Fix) for Guardian MODIFY verdicts
widgets/input_box.py - Input with slash command suggestions
widgets/status_bar.py - Status bar with provider, section, tokens, cost

legacy_AgentRuntime.role: Default runtime used by TUI bridge, CLI, and GUI web bridge
features: ReAct loop with ToolEngine, PromptBuilder, ContextMemory, OutputParser
ProviderRegistry integration with retry + token tracking
Skills injection, MCP tool catalog injection
Plan mode gating (awaits user approval before execution)
Streaming token deltas via on_token_delta callback

v2_AgentRuntimeV2.role: Opt-in wrapper adding modern async architecture
features: ChatStateActor - asyncio single-task owner of conversation state (no locks)
InterjectionBuffer - mid-turn user messages queued and drained at safe points
SubagentV2 - toolset-level read-only guarantee (explore/plan have NO write tools)
CancelToken - cooperative cancellation propagated through actor hierarchy

providers: nvidia_nim (NVIDIA NIM - https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1, default meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct, NVIDIA_API_KEY)
provider_system.auto_router: Task complexity classifier → model tier catalog (planned for smart routing)

modes: OpenAI-compatible (dynamic, no code) - type: openai_compatible with api_base, env_var, capabilities
custom_providers.registration: Auto-registered in ProviderRegistry and AutoRouter on init, reload_registry() for hot-reload

gui.bridge: clew.web_bridge.bridge.ClewBridge (QObject with @Slot methods mirroring TUI bridge)
key_features: Same API surface as TUI bridge
Shared session state via persistence layer

guardian_safety.risk_scoring: Rule-based: critical paths (/etc, /root, .ssh), dangerous commands (rm -rf, dd, sudo), file writes outside workspace
guardian_safety.llm_review: Optional LLM review of risky calls, returns APPROVE/REJECT/MODIFY with rationale
guardian_safety.subagent_reviewer: review_with_subagent() uses read-only explore subagent for second opinion
guardian_safety.ui_integration: MODIFY verdict shows 3-button modal in both TUI and GUI

progressive_tools.catalog: TOOL_CATALOG ~44 tools in sections: file ops, code execution, search, git, agent, knowledge, office, MCP
progressive_tools.mechanism: Monkey-patched dispatch in legacy runtime; clean toolset-level enforcement in v2

compaction.legacy: Auto-compact at 85% threshold, keeps last 4 messages, summarizes via LLM

v2_three_tier.code: Full-session replace — summarize entire history, rebuild fresh
v2_three_tier.intra: Tail-keep, per-turn — summarize tool-call history of current turn, keep last N messages
v2_three_tier.inter: Chunked, between-turn summarization pipeline — each chunk summarized separately, concatenated

compaction.context_fragments: Marker-based (<context_fragment type=... id=...>) preserved across compaction with tombstones

persistence.sqlite: ~/.clew/chats.sqlite3 (WAL mode, O(log N) append, load_range for pagination)
persistence.context_memory: Auto-dispatches to SQLitePersistence when path ends in .db/.sqlite/.sqlite3

token_management.budget: TokenBudget (daily_usd, monthly_usd, max_tokens_per_turn, max_iterations, compaction_threshold_pct, prompt_caching, predictable_mode)
token_management.check: check_budget() called by AgentRuntime._generate_with_retry() BEFORE every LLM call - fails OPEN with friendly error
token_management.tracker: TokenTracker with MODEL_PRICING, 30-day rotation, live pricing override
token_management.quota: QuotaTracker per-section daily limits (general=50, heavy_code=10, office=20 free tier)

request_queues.per_provider: RequestQueue with max_concurrency (default 1 = strict serialization), max_queue_size, cooldown after 429, exponential backoff retries (default 3, capped at 8s)
request_queues.wrap_provider: Monkey-patches provider.generate/stream to go through queue

collaboration_modes.reviewer: Implementer + reviewer loop with APPROVE/REJECT/MODIFY verdicts (max_iterations rounds)
collaboration_modes.codegen: Planner decomposes task → N parallel implementers → results concatenated
collaboration_modes.pair: Two agents alternate turns on same task (rounds total)
collaboration_modes.observer: One worker + N read-only observers; warnings collected into metadata['warnings']

second_opinion.purpose: Cross-model review BEFORE risky tool commit (Pro-gated)
second_opinion.differs_from_guardian: Guardian = rule-based + same-provider LLM review; Second Opinion = ALWAYS cross-model, Pro-gated, separate UI panel
second_opinion.fails_open: Any error returns APPROVE so feature never blocks user

verification.purpose: Cross-model verification AFTER agent answers (catches hallucinations, missing edge cases)
verification.flow: bridge.verify_last_response() picks cross-family verifier, sends user prompt + agent answer, returns JSON verdict (overall, correctness, safety, completeness, issues[], suggestions[], summary)
verification.ui: TUI VerificationModal (PASS/WARN/FAIL colors), GUI @Slot for JS panel

capability_catalog.auto_discovery: Missing placeholders in body auto-added as required

activity_log.features: Bounded deque, thread-safe, subscribable (live UI), export_json, hash-chain ready for audit trail

builtin: explore (read-only: read_file, search_project, grep, glob, list_files, get_project_structure, file_info, git_status, git_diff, list_mcp_tools, get_skill, select_tools)
subagents.user_defined: ~/.clew/agents/*.md or <project>/.clew/agents/*.md with YAML frontmatter (name, description, tools, model, isolation)

sandbox.enforcement: Landlock (Linux), Seatbelt (macOS), pure-Python fallback (no kernel enforcement)
sandbox.irreversible: Once applied, cannot be relaxed at runtime

mcp.client_manager: MCP client/manager for Model Context Protocol
mcp.tool_catalog: Typed catalog (mcp__<server>__<tool> with full JSON Schema) injected into system prompt

data_flows.user_message_tui: InputBox → ClewBridge.run_turn() → AgentRuntime.run() → ReAct loop → on_event → ChatLog
data_flows.user_message_gui: JS → QWebChannel → ClewBridge @Slot → AgentRuntime.run() → Qt signals → JS callbacks
data_flows.tool_execution: AgentRuntime → ToolEngine.execute() → Guardian risk assessment → LLM review (if enabled) → Confirmation callback (if autonomy=always_ask) → Tool dispatch → ActivityLog.record()
data_flows.provider_call: AgentRuntime._generate_with_retry() → RequestQueue → Provider.generate() → CircuitBreaker.record() → TokenTracker.record() → QuotaTracker.record() → TokenBudget.check_budget()
data_flows.compaction: AgentRuntime._maybe_auto_compact() → ContextMemory.compact() or CompactionEngine (v2) → summary replaces old messages
data_flows.second_opinion: Guardian flags risky call → SecondOpinionConfig.enabled → resolve_second_provider() → review_with_second_model() → verdict → Guardian modal
data_flows.verification: /verify command → bridge.verify_last_response() → cross-family provider → JSON verdict → VerificationModal / GUI panel

config_files.~/.clew/config.json: token_budget, second_opinion, clew_pro, project_root, storage_backend, guardian_level, provider_config
config_files.~/.clew/providers.yaml: Custom provider definitions (OpenAI-compatible, class import, file load)
config_files.~/.clew/providers/: Plugin directory for custom provider .py files
config_files.<project>/.clew/: Project-level overrides for capabilities, agents, skills, CLAUDE.md/CLEW.md

key_architectural_decisions.no_telemetry: No analytics, crash reporting, usage stats
key_architectural_decisions.local_first: Ollama/LM Studio default; cloud APIs opt-in
key_architectural_decisions.activity_log_first_class: Unified audit trail for every tool call
key_architectural_decisions.boundary_rule: clew_tui never imports clew internals - only via ClewBridge
key_architectural_decisions.v2_opt_in: AgentRuntimeV2 wraps legacy, adds async actor model, opt-in via from_legacy()

monetization_foundation.m2_smart_routing: Planned - TaskComplexity + model tier catalog + quota-aware routing

growth_features.g1_custom_providers: Complete - YAML config + plugin dir + auto-registration
growth_features.g8_polish: Ongoing - TUI/GUI bug fixes, fast iteration
